title: moved from heroku to google fine but looking to find the data api
symptom: After migrating from Heroku to Google Cloud, the user's Fitbit clock face (from pedantic avenger) requests a DATA API URL and fails with the new host. Another user reports that xDrip as follower gets 'NS entries download was not succesful:401 unautorized' when using the NS follower box.
cause: The thread explains that Heroku did not impose a limit on outgoing bandwidth, but on Google Cloud, if outgoing bandwidth goes over 1GB/month, it will not be free. To minimize egress by default, the AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES variable is set to 'denied', which blocks unauthenticated read access, causing devices like Fitbit and xDrip that do not use tokens to fail.
fix: Change the Nightscout variable AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES from 'denied' to 'readable' and restart the server. This is a workaround for devices that cannot use tokens. The thread also suggests using apps/devices that support tokens as the proper solution.
evidence_quote: The variable name is the following. AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES The value it is set to now on your system must be: denied If you want to try the experiment, change it to: readable
